title: US daylight saving time 2026 ends; clocks fall back 1 hour, sleep experts object
content: Daylight saving time concluded on November 1, resulting in darker evenings and an extra hour of sleep. The debate continues over making daylight saving time a permanent fixture instead of switching twice yearly. Recent legislation has stalled in the Senate despite bipartisan support from the House. Public opinion favors maintaining standard time over permanent daylight saving time due to sleep cycle considerations.

title: Pippa Middleton ordered to demolish car park at £15.5m estate
content: Pippa Middleton, Princess Catherine’s sister, and her husband James Matthews have been ordered to demolish an unauthorised car park at their £15.5 million Barton Court estate. West Berkshire Council ruled against the development after local residents objected to construction without consultation, citing concerns over its impact on the rural character of Kintbury.

title: Delaware couple wins land dispute after neighbours demand $30,000
content: After two decades of contention, a Delaware court officially awarded Joseph W.C. Murray, Jr. and Danielle F. Murray ownership of a long-disputed parcel of land. The case arose when the Preradovic family challenged property lines after purchasing an adjacent lot. Failed negotiations led to litigation, ultimately resulting in the court granting the Murrays the rear yard while their claims to the front areas were rejected.

title: Man And Bear Sanctuary: Bosnian electrician’s rescue reshapes family home; future of bears uncertain
content: In 2019, electrician Petar Tubic stumbled upon a deserted bear cub named Masa in the woods. Over time, he nurtured Masa, eventually establishing a sanctuary for rescued animals, which now includes an additional bear, Ljubica. However, Tubic is troubled by their strong human bonds, raising concern over the bears' future. The sanctuary has transformed into a community attraction and draws attention to the complexities involved in wildlife rescue.

title: US senators write to Google CEO Sundar Pichai with 9 questions on classroom AI push
content: Two US senators have requested answers from Google CEO Sundar Pichai about the effects of AI tools on children. They highlighted concerns regarding the integration of AI products in schools and their potential negative impacts. The senators have set a deadline for a response by November 2, 2026. They specifically seek information on research conducted about AI's impact on children’s mental health.

title: 4.1bn-year-old pink Mars rock found in Sahara holds clues to ancient water
content: Discovered in the vast Sahara Desert, the meteorite Teghaza 001 is over four billion years old and is confirmed to be a Martian rock via isotopic studies. This intriguing specimen reveals a volcanic history intertwined with water activity, indicating a complex water cycle on Mars. As researchers delve deeper into its origins, they are unraveling vital insights into the planet's early environmental conditions.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio estate faces new security concerns
content: Travis Kelce's $5.35 million Ohio mansion is facing fresh neighborhood tensions as residents challenge proposed property changes over concerns about lake views, tree height and a century-old shared sewer line. The dispute comes weeks after reports revealed that Kelce and Taylor Swift installed an audible security system to discourage trespassers. The village's architectural review board has delayed its decision and plans to revisit the revised proposal on November 10.

title: Andhra school chainsaw attack: Accused shot in encounter while attempting to flee
content: Hemanth was shot during a police encounter after being located in the Atmakur forest area. Special police teams attempted to apprehend him following a dangerous chainsaw attack on a student. Upon being approached, Hemanth resisted arrest, threw stones, and attempted to attack officers. As a result, the police fired six rounds, critically injuring him. He has since been transported to the hospital for necessary medical treatment under heavy security.

title: 'Restore fighter strength': New IAF chief outlines roadmap, puts Tejas and AMCA on top
content: In his inaugural address, Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit outlined key priorities for the Indian Air Force, focusing on restoring combat squadron strength and ramping up indigenous aircraft initiatives. He stressed the necessity for operational readiness and self-reliance amid evolving security dynamics and technological advancements in warfare. Additionally, Dixit reaffirmed his dedication to supporting the welfare of air warriors and their families, ensuring their needs receive optimal attention.

title: Super Sunday for India! Lakshya ends title drought as Sindhu completes double delight
content: Lakshya Sen has finally ended his title drought by clinching the men's singles crown at the Hylo Open 2026, where he decisively defeated Jonatan Christie with scores of 21-17 and 21-10 in an exhilarating final held in Saarbrücken, Germany. PV Sindhu also shone brightly, securing her second title of the season against Line Højmark Kjærsfeldt in the women's singles final.

title: 15 policemen suspended after rape of woman inside Jharkhand police station
content: In Jharkhand, the suspension of fifteen police officers highlights a grave concern following the reported rape of a 20-year-old woman at the Gamharia police station. Initially, nine officers faced suspension for negligence, but the investigation's depth led to the arrest of two sub-inspectors and a constable. The Seraikela-Kharsawan SP has made it clear that harsh penalties await the guilty as the inquiry progresses.

title: AI may automate routine IT work. These are the skills that could command a pay premium
content: As execution costs collapse toward zero, compensation and enterprise value are decoupling from traditional job titles and tenure. Instead, value is concentrating at the intersection of technical depth, domain context, and human judgment.

title: MLS rule saves Lionel Messi from suspension despite fifth yellow card this season
content: Lionel Messi will be available for Inter Miami's crucial clash against New England Revolution despite collecting his fifth yellow card of the MLS season. The Argentine escapes an automatic suspension thanks to MLS's Good Behaviour Incentive, which allows players to erase bookings after five consecutive matches without disciplinary action. The rule has reduced his active tally to three cautions.

title: Bigg Boss 20 Weekend Ka Vaar: Aasif Khan evicted; Scout and YUNG DSA break down

Aasif built meaningful relationships throughout the competition, managing to stay connected despite occasional separations from his group.

title: Bhutan dedicates Buddhist stupa to PM Modi; Rijiju calls it ‘huge honour’ for India

This event took place in Gelephu Mindfulness City, where 108 stupas are being raised. Union minister Kiren Rijiju represented India, conveying PM Modi's gratitude. The stupa, numbered 76, represents the strong ties shared by the two nations.

title: US midterms: Trump ready with plan to outmaneuver Democrat-controlled Congress

These include policies on immigration, tariffs, housing costs and federal spending, according to a White House official and two people familiar with the plans.

title: Harmanpreet's hat-trick sinks Malaysia as India keep perfect ACT unbeaten record

Harmanpreet Singh mesmerized fans by netting a spectacular hat-trick, while Sukhjeet Singh added to the excitement with a brilliant field goal. Although Malaysia briefly leveled the score, they couldn't maintain their momentum. This victory leaves India unbeaten as they gear up for their next challenge against South Korea.

title: 'Monkey still on my back': Tim Seifert rues missed century, hails Glenn Phillips

New Zealand triumphed with a seven-wicket win, albeit losing the series 2-3 overall. Seifert credited the team’s growth and adaptive strategies, while Glenn Phillips shone brightly, setting a new record for runs in a bilateral T20I series. Seifert lauded Phillips for his pivotal role in the team's batting success.

title: China's mysterious submarine could give US Navy a Pacific nightmare

This submarine could possess between 16 and 18 of China's cutting-edge YJ-20 hypersonic anti-ship missiles. Its tactics may feature submerging before launching surprise missile strikes on enemy ships, presenting serious implications for US Navy strategic operations.

title: 9 dead as Florida jet crashes near busy roadway
content:
Emergency crews respond after a Learjet 60 crashed into a South Florida neighbourhood, killing all nine people on board

All nine people aboard a business jet were killed after it crashed into a South Florida neighbourhood on Sunday, US transportation secretary Sean Duffy said. The Learjet 60, which departed from Austin, Texas, was headed to the Bahamas when it nose-dived into the neighbourhood and burst into flames. The crash created a large fiery crater in the pavement near a busy roadway, news agency AP reported. The aircraft appeared to narrowly miss nearby homes before crashing, according to initial reports. Duffy said the Federal Aviation Administration was sending a team to assist the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) in investigating the cause of the crash. The circumstances leading to the crash and the identities of those killed were not immediately clear.
